sources.entry: DayBar - An application that can display the local date and reminder events in the menu bar. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/daybar/6739052447?platform=mac)

summary.name: DayBar
summary.one_liner: DayBar is a macOS menu bar app that shows the local date and reminder events, and opens a calendar view with events and reminders synced from Apple Calendar.
use_cases: See today's date and upcoming events from the menu bar
Check the current month's calendar events quickly
Manage Apple Reminders TODO items from the status bar
View Chinese lunar dates alongside the Gregorian calendar
summary.what_it_does: DayBar displays the local date and reminder events in the macOS menu bar. Clicking it opens a view of the calendar, calendar events, and reminders. It synchronizes with Apple Calendar. The app shows the Chinese lunar calendar and the current week number, and marks days that have events with an indicator. Double-clicking opens the Calendar and Reminders apps, and the app can list all events for the current month and remind you of TODO tasks.
notable: Chinese lunar calendar shown in the menu bar popover
Syncs with Apple Calendar and Reminders
Double-click to open Calendar and Reminders apps
Available on the Mac App Store (v4.2.0)
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Requires Apple Calendar and Reminders integration; works only on macOS as far as the page shows
